title: Director of Business Development

role_match.role_rationale_from_stage3: Durst's active presence at PRINTING United, ISA Expo, and Labelexpo demonstrates aggressive market expansion and customer acquisition efforts. Business Development owns revenue growth, market penetration, and strategic partnerships that expand Durst's addressable market and competitive advantage. Tedlar represents a compelling partner solution that allows Durst to offer a complete outdoor durability story to sign manufacturers, vehicle wrap installers, and architectural graphics producers—addressing a critical downstream need that affects customer satisfaction and repeat business. This role is measured on pipeline growth, partnership revenue, win rates against competitors, and market share expansion. By establishing Tedlar as a certified or recommended protective film partner, they can create joint go-to-market initiatives, co-selling opportunities, and bundled solutions that position Durst as the premium choice for outdoor applications. Given Durst's emphasis on outdoor signage, billboards, and vehicle graphics—all markets where substrate protection directly impacts end-user satisfaction—this role would immediately see the value in a partnership that reduces customer complaints, extends product lifespan, and creates a differentiated selling proposition that drives both equipment sales and recurring consumables revenue.

engagement_strategy.scope_and_authority: This Director owns revenue growth through strategic partnerships, channel development, and market expansion initiatives. They likely influence or directly approve partnership agreements, co-marketing programs, and ecosystem integrations that enhance Durst's competitive positioning. Their scope spans identifying complementary solution providers, structuring joint go-to-market strategies, and creating bundled offerings that increase win rates. They report to C-level executives (likely SVP Sales or Chief Commercial Officer) and collaborate closely with Product Management, Sales Engineering, and Marketing. Their authority centers on partnership selection, deal structuring, and revenue pipeline creation through strategic alliances.
engagement_strategy.relevant_use_cases: For Durst's outdoor signage customers (billboards, transit advertising, architectural graphics), Tedlar provides UV protection and weather resistance that extends graphics lifespan from 3-5 years to 12-20+ years—reducing replacement frequency and total cost of ownership. For vehicle wrap installers using Durst printers, Tedlar's graffiti resistance solves a major pain point where fleet graphics get vandalized with spray paint or stickers, allowing easy cleanup without graphic replacement. For architectural panel producers, Tedlar's temperature range (-70°F to 230°F) and mold resistance enables Durst customers to confidently bid on challenging outdoor installations where other overlaminates fail. These use cases directly support Durst's customers' success, reducing their operational costs and complaints while differentiating Durst as a solutions provider who cares about end-user outcomes—not just equipment sales.
engagement_strategy.personal_stakes: This role is measured on partnership-sourced revenue, pipeline contribution from strategic alliances, market share growth in target verticals, and win rates against competitors like HP, EFI, and Mimaki. They care about creating differentiated selling propositions that help Durst sales teams close deals, particularly in the premium segment where Durst emphasizes quality and reliability. Reducing customer complaints about downstream performance issues (UV fading, graphics failure) protects Durst's brand reputation and prevents lost deals due to negative word-of-mouth. By partnering with Tedlar, they can offer a certified protective solution that extends Durst's value proposition beyond the printer to the complete outdoor graphics workflow—creating a competitive moat, enabling premium pricing, and generating co-selling opportunities that drive both equipment and consumables revenue.
engagement_strategy.timing_factors: Durst exhibited as Platinum sponsor at PRINTING United Expo 2025 (January 28-30) and won eleven 2025 PRINTING United Alliance Pinnacle Awards, demonstrating active market investment and recognition. They launched the P5 X flatbed printer in late 2024 and the P5 SMP hybrid system at DRUPA 2024, indicating they're in growth mode with new product go-to-market initiatives. ISA Sign Expo 2026 (April 23-25, Orlando) is a key industry event where protective films and outdoor durability are major discussion topics. Durst's emphasis on outdoor applications (billboards, signage, vehicle graphics) and their positioning around durability and reliability creates strong strategic alignment for a protective film partnership discussion. The current timing is ideal as they're actively seeking differentiation strategies following recent product launches and heading into major industry events where outdoor performance is a critical buying factor.

personalization_hooks.hook: Durst's positioning emphasizes 'performance, reliability, flexibility and longevity' for outdoor applications, but end-user graphics often fail prematurely due to overlaminate degradation—creating customer dissatisfaction that affects equipment repurchase decisions
personalization_hooks.messaging_angle: Frame Tedlar as a strategic partner that protects Durst's brand promise by ensuring customer graphics actually deliver the durability Durst's printers enable. Position this as a downstream success problem that affects Durst's competitive positioning and customer retention.

personalization_hooks.hook: Durst's recent P5 X and P5 SMP launches target premium outdoor segments (architectural graphics, billboards, vehicle wraps) where protective film performance directly impacts customer ROI and competitive differentiation
personalization_hooks.messaging_angle: Reference their new product launches and suggest Tedlar as a certified partner solution that strengthens their go-to-market story for these premium outdoor applications. Frame it as a way to differentiate against HP and EFI competitors who lack proven outdoor protection partnerships.

personalization_hooks.hook: Durst's active presence at PRINTING United 2025 and upcoming ISA Sign Expo 2026 indicates focus on market expansion and thought leadership in outdoor graphics—where protective film technology is increasingly becoming a competitive differentiator
personalization_hooks.messaging_angle: Propose a joint presence or co-marketing initiative at ISA Sign Expo 2026, where Durst can demonstrate a complete outdoor durability solution that combines their printing technology with proven protective film performance. Position Tedlar as helping them own the 'outdoor durability' conversation in their market.

recommended_approach: Lead with strategic partnership angle focused on competitive differentiation and revenue growth. Frame Tedlar as a co-selling opportunity that strengthens Durst's positioning in premium outdoor segments, rather than just a product recommendation. Reference their recent product launches and active market presence to demonstrate relevance and timing. Emphasize how a protective film partnership reduces downstream customer complaints that affect equipment repurchase decisions and win rates.
